title: fix(spec)!: a page action row declares ActionSchema's operation and refuses onSuccess beside operation: 'update', with the action's text
body:
Fixes #23332

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

The page action rows (`action:button`, `action:icon`, and each `action:group` / `action:menu` member) and `ActionSchema` now give one answer for `operation: 'update'` plus `onSuccess`. Direction of record: triage `6154972534` (consistent with #23168's answer C, `6148462268`), within the PM's premised ruling.

## Premise check, done first: `ActionSchema`'s refusal is the right half

The ruling's premise: no runtime consumer honors `onSuccess` after an `operation: 'update'` write as a declared, tested behavior. It holds. Read at objectui's `.objectui-sha` pin `1fb1ced36243` (the runner file is byte-identical at objectui `main` `b9814b3`):

- **What the runner does mechanically.** `ActionRunner.execute` reads `operation` before any executor (`core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:1384-1388`). `executeUpdateOperation` posts the write through the registered `script` dispatch, and then `handlePostExecution` runs. That function performs the `onSuccess` hop for every branch on success (`:1639-1642`). So the hop would fire after the write, but only because every branch shares the same post-execution path.
- **It is not declared.** The runner's own docblock for `onSuccess` (`:1620-1638`) says the key is "refine-scoped to `type: 'api'` and `type: 'script'`" and that the spec's declared meaning is its only meaning. objectui's metadata-admin form puts `onSuccess` in `UPDATE_OPERATION_REFUSES` (`app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx:336-353`), calls it "a navigation the write has no business doing", and clears it when an author switches an action into an update (`commitOperation`, `:620-628`).
- **It is not tested.** No objectui file at the pin pins the pairing. `ActionRunner.onSuccessNavigation.test.ts` has no `operation` in it, and `ActionRunner.updateOperation.test.ts` has no `onSuccess`. Of the 55 files that write `operation: 'update'`, the 10 that also mention `onSuccess` were each read: none puts the two on one action.

So the rule stays as `ActionSchema` has it, and the rows take it. ⛔ `ActionSchema` was not widened.

## What changes

**1. A row's `operation` is `ActionSchema`'s own enum, by reference** (`component.zod.ts`, `actionOperation()` = `ActionSchema.in.shape.operation.unwrap()`). It is read the same way `actionOnSuccessBlock()` reads `onSuccess`, so there is no second vocabulary: the one member is `'update'`, and `'delete'` / `'custom'` get the action's own "bulk-def operation with no row-level form" refusal. Before this, the rows typed it `z.unknown()`. The runner tests `operation === 'update'` and lets any other value fall through to the executor, where it did nothing.

**2. A row's `onSuccess` beside `operation: 'update'` is refused whatever executor the row names (or none)**, as `ActionSchema` refuses it on every `type`. `refuseRowOnSuccessBesideExecutor` reads `operation` first, the way the runner does, and gives ONE issue at `onSuccess`. Before this:

| row | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actionType: 'api'` or `'script'` or a host handler, `operation: 'update'`, `onSuccess` | accepted | refused at `onSuccess`, with the update text |
| no executor, `operation: 'update'`, `onSuccess` | refused with the no-executor text ("has no executor to follow" … declare `actionType: 'script'`), which does not fit this shape | refused with the update text |
| `operation: 'update'` and no `onSuccess`, on any executor | accepted | accepted (unchanged) |

**3. One refusal text, from one place.** The new `onSuccessBesideUpdateOperationRefusal(subject)` lives in `action-on-success-executor.ts`, the module PR #23331 created for this purpose (relative import only, outside the `ui` barrel). `ActionSchema`'s `DECLARATIVE_UPDATE_REFUSED_KEYS` `onSuccess` entry and the rows both read it. The text says what the row does at run time, as the card asks:

> An `action:button`'s `onSuccess` (`operation: 'update'`) would follow a result the contract does not declare: the console's action runner reads `operation` before any executor, so an `operation: 'update'` action runs no handler and no executor of its own (the platform action route writes `patch` to the current record as the caller), and the runner then performs the post-success hop after that write succeeds. `${result.*}` reads a handler's return or a call's response, and the declarative write declares neither. Drop `onSuccess`; post-success navigation after the declarative write is a spec proposal, not a silent key.

On `ActionSchema` the subject is "An `operation: 'update'` action's `onSuccess`". The text used to open "`onSuccess` is not defined for an `operation: 'update'` action yet". Its reach is unchanged, and the "Drop `onSuccess`" prescription is kept.

## Accept-set narrowing (BREAKING, `minor`, ADR-0087 `registered ui-page-action-row-operation-declared`)

Values a row accepted before and now refuses:
- any `operation` other than `'update'`: `'delete'` and `'custom'` (with the action's prescription), and anything else (`invalid_value`);
- `onSuccess` beside `operation: 'update'`, on any executor.

**Producers measured:** none in this repository at `339604baf`. I checked `examples/` (the only page action rows are in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/index.ts` and `src/ui/actions/index.ts`, and neither carries `operation`), the CLI corpus (`packages/cli`, `skills/`) and the dogfood fixtures (`packages/qa`). In objectui at the pin `1fb1ced36243` and at `main` `b9814b3`, the action renderers' tests carry `operation: 'update'` rows without `onSuccess` (accepted, unchanged). No row carries another `operation` value or the pairing. objectui's registration already publishes `operation` as `enum: ['update']` (`action-button.tsx:584-590`), so its `registry-inputs-spec-parity` enum check gets a member the spec accepts. hotcrm: NOT MEASURED (no checkout in this container).

Semantic migration entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-page-action-row-operation-declared.ts`, beside the `18.ui-page-action-row-*` family. Changeset `.changeset/23332-page-action-row-operation.md`.

## Pins, each with a negative control

- **Row side** (`component-action-row-on-success-executor.test.ts` §4), on all four rows:
  - REFUSAL: `onSuccess` beside `operation: 'update'` with no executor and with `api` / `script` / `run`. The test asserts ONE issue at `onSuccess` plus the full first sentence.
  - NEGATIVE CONTROL: the same rows without `onSuccess` parse.
  - ONE TEXT: the row message after its subject equals `ActionSchema`'s message after its subject.
  - NO SECOND VOCABULARY: every row holds the very enum instance `ActionSchema.operation` declares.
  - `'delete'` is refused with the action's exact message, `'create'` gets `invalid_value` at `operation`, and the `'update'` accepted control passes.
- **`ActionSchema` side** (`action-row-update.test.ts`):
  - The mixing-rule pin is flipped to the new opening, a prefix of the text that bears the load.
  - New: `onSuccess` beside `operation: 'update'` (no `type` and explicit `type: 'script'`) gives exactly one issue, at `onSuccess`, and the same action without it parses.
- **The `os validate` door** (`packages/lint/src/validate-component-props-row-on-success.test.ts`): one `component-props-invalid` finding at `…onSuccess` for `api` + update + `onSuccess`, nothing without `onSuccess`, and one finding at `…operation` for `'delete'`.
- **Ledger:** `component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts` deletes the `operation` line, because a typed member deletes its line.

**Pin sweep:** I grepped the old message ("not defined for an `operation: 'update'`") across this repo: one pin, flipped (`action-row-update.test.ts:218`). objectui at the pin and at `main`: zero hits.

**Ablations** (committed tree, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; every leg restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty; spec tests import `src`, so no dist was involved):
- The row branch was turned off (`if (row.operation === 'update')` changed to `if (false as boolean)`). Result: 20 red (16 REFUSAL + 4 ONE TEXT), and the negative controls stayed green.
- `ActionSchema`'s `onSuccess` entry was deleted. Result: 6 red (both `ActionSchema` pins + 4 ONE TEXT). My first attempt used an empty `--replacement`, which the tool refused as a no-op (count 0 to 0). It was re-run with `--delete`.
- The row enum was replaced by `z.unknown()`. Result: 9 red (8 operation refusals + NO SECOND VOCABULARY).

## Verification at `339604baf` (after merging `origin/main` `5656c5638`)

- `@objectstack/spec`:
  - Targeted files after the merge rebuild: 4 files, 289 passed.
  - `--project local`: 672 of 673 files green before the ledger fix. The 3 failures were all in `component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts` (the typed `operation` member's line), and that file is now 69/69.
  - `test:repo`: 59 files, 1011 passed.
  - `typecheck` (tsc, scripts, test-typecheck): exit 0.
  - `check:generated`: green after `gen:docs` (`content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` regenerated).
- `@objectstack/lint`: 138 files, 6706 passed; `typecheck`: exit 0.
- Consumer readings (`ComponentPropsMap` parsers): `cloud-connection` and `mcp` `canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts` 16 and 11 passed; `platform-objects` `pages/canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts` 15 passed.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 111 families, all 111 run on `339604baf`, every one exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "111 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 111 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". `check:nul-bytes` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, same family (rows vs `ActionSchema` on the declarative-update mixing rule): the rows carry none of `ActionSchema`'s other `operation: 'update'` refusals. These were measured on the built spec: `patch` without `operation`, `target` beside update, a non-script executor beside update, update with nothing to write, and `list_toolbar` beside update each parse on `action:button` and are refused by `ActionSchema`. Reported to the seat for the family's closing card. Not fixed here.
- Not touched: `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` (#23357). The sentence at `component.zod.ts:6030` ("a stored page still saves and loads") is far from this diff and still true until #23418 lands, so it was left alone. The new migration entry's sentence "A page's `properties` is not parsed on the metadata save or load path" follows its family's current text, and #23418 rewrites that text in the sibling entries. Whichever PR lands later should align this entry too.
- `Clause-②`: the PM's claim declared `yes`, conservatively and conditionally ("if measurement moves the rule on ActionSchema's side, which would widen it"). Measurement did not move it, so this PR declares `no (narrowing)`, as triage's direction records for this outcome.
